rows.en:
Oh, that's sweet of you, \p.
I'll make sure to savor it later.
rows.notes: Sumanai (thanks/sorry for the trouble) rendered as thanks.

rows.en:
I'll pay you back properly on White Day,
so look forward to it.

Michel-kun, you don't have to
give me anything back.

Don't worry about it.
I just want to pay you back properly, that's all.

(I'm glad I managed to give Michel-kun
the chocolate. I wonder what he'll give me
back on White Day?)

(I feel bad for Michel-kun, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give him the chocolate...)

(I bought chocolate for Luca-kun, since
we get along so well, but now that it's
time to give it, I'm so nervous...)
Give Luca-kun chocolate
Don't give Luca-kun chocolate

Here, Luca-kun.
Some Valentine's chocolate for you.

Thank you so much,
\p-san.
I'll make sure to enjoy it later.

I'll pay you back properly on White Day,
so please look forward to it.

Luca-kun, you don't have to
give me anything back.

Oh, no, I have to pay you back properly.
I'd be happier if you'd accept it.

(I'm glad I managed to give Luca-kun
the chocolate. I wonder what he'll give me
back on White Day?)

(I feel bad for Luca-kun, but it's just too
embarrassing. I can't give him the chocolate...)

Morning, Nanase.
Did you need me for something?

Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Nanase!
Oh, no, it's really nothing special...

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Nanase.

R-really?
Then I'm glad I gave it to you.

(Hmm... School's already over, and in the end
I didn't get chocolate from anyone...)
\p-kuuun!
Huh? What's up, Ranka?

It's Valentine's Day, so I wanted to give
you some chocolate, \p-kun, but...

Actually, I forgot it at home,
so I hurried back to get it.
Here, this chocolate's for you!

Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Ranka!
Sorry it's nothing special.

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Ranka.

R-really?
Then I'm glad I gave it to you!

Mm-hm! Well, I've got my part-time job,
so I'd better get going!
rows.notes: Un answers the player's thanks (c21816, shared row).

rows.en:
Oh, \p.
You've come at just the right time.

Morning, Sheryl.
Did you need me for something?

Today's Valentine's, the day you give chocolate,
right? So I'm giving you some, \p,
for working so hard as my errand boy.
rows.notes: Komazukai (errand runner, servant): 'errand boy' as this scene is male-only.

rows.en:
Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thanks, Sheryl.
It's nothing that special.

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Sheryl.

R-really?
Then it seems giving it to you was worth it.

My, how honest. Very good.
Well then, shall we head to class?
rows.notes: Sunao de yoroshii: praises the player's plain thanks (c21816).

rows.en:
Oh, good morning, Klan-senpai.
Did you need me for something?
Indeed. Today is Valentine's Day, after all.
rows.notes: Klan's stiff, archaic register (umu, ... no da).

rows.en:
Since it looks like nobody's going to give
you any chocolate, I thought I'd bestow
some upon you myself.
rows.notes: Full strength: she assumes no one else will give the player chocolate.

rows.en:
Huh?! You're giving me chocolate?
Thank you so much, Klan-senpai!
It's nothing special...

Obligation chocolate or not, I'm happy
to get chocolate from you, Klan-senpai.

Hm, is that so?
Then I'm glad I gave it to you.

Oh, class will be starting soon.
Off to the classroom with you, quickly.
(Today's the Culture Fest I've been waiting for!)

(I heard our class was going to run an
authentic Chinese restaurant for the Fest...)
rows.notes: x4: shared male/female. 'Dashimono' (class attraction) folded into 'for the Fest'; the trailing 'kedo...' kept as the ellipsis.

rows.en: (I never thought they'd go this all-out...)

Mornin', \p!
Amazing, right? It's just like being inside
the real Nyan-Nyan!

Wait... This was just a regular classroom
until yesterday, right...?

Yup, sure was!
I gave the classroom a quick remodel
to make it look just like Nyan-Nyan!
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Kaizou = remodel (Yui is a tinkerer).

rows.en:
(I feel like this has gone way past 'remodel'.
It's a total transformation...)

\p-kun, Yui,
we don't have time for idle chatter.
Hurry up and get ready to open.
Yeah, got i......
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Cut off mid-word as in the Japanese (wakat......).

rows.en:
Wait, you even got Nyan-Nyan
china dresses ready, huh...

Well, of course!
If we're going to do this, we have to go all out.
(Ha ha, that's Shirakawa for you.)

Geez, you're all getting way too worked up
over a mere Culture Fest.

What're you talking about, Alto?
It's the Culture Fest. That's exactly
why we should enjoy it.

Oh, right. Isn't there a china dress for Alto?
A women's one, of course.

Ummm, hold on.
I'll go look for one right now...
There's no way I'm ever wearing that!

(Alto in a china dress, huh...
Part of me kind of wants to see that...)

(Whoops, this is no time for daydreaming.
I've gotta hurry and get ready to open.)

(Thanks partly to the china dresses,
business is booming. But that means we're
so busy we're short on hands...)
Ooh, business seems to be booming.
It really is. This is impressive!

Oh, Klan-senpai, Claire-senpai!
Welcome!

We're so busy right now I can't step away.
I'm sorry I can't keep you company
when you came all this way.

Oh, that's fine. Just getting to look at
girls in cute outfits like this is enough
to satisfy me...

(I feel like Claire-senpai just said
something kind of dangerous...)
Oh, I know! I've got a great idea.
A great idea?
Hee hee, how do I look, \p-kun?
rows.notes: Claire has changed into a china dress. Male version (c22019 female, -chan).

rows.en: It looks great on you, of course, Claire-senpai.

But are you sure about this?
Helping out with our class's booth?

It's fine. It looked like fun,
and I kind of wanted to try on a china dress.

Well then, I'll go take some orders
right away.
